test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A is sitting second to the left of C. F is sitting to the immediate right of C. D is an immediate neighbour of both A and E. Who is sitting third to the right of E?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

1) A is sitting second to the left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66f10ec9901214c1e7058a3fe62a726b7bf361aa6cec574fb7fde435982605f4.png] 

2) F is sitting to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22b89a01f8eb8a7c1856ec2b9128350d806f8a3d3ca08bd9b320ca5a076cb469.png] 

3) D is an immediate neighbour of both A and E.

After positioning D and E only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e9cf4c2c92bf4c4aaffb5aadbdd7926dad808fac88d9ff7978276211ad0a6a4.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, B is sitting third to the right of E.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
